section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing any Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Audited artifact schema_id is 'orch.tier5.impact_section.v1' (a Phase 8 Tier 5 deliverable). The budget gate at docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json has gate_pass_declaration: 'fail' with blocking inconsistency BLK-01 ('received/ contains no lump-sum budget response'). A Phase 8 proposal section exists on disk while the budget gate has not passed, which CLAUDE.md §13.4 and §8.4 categorically prohibit.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow progress when inputs are incomplete.
Finalising proposal text when source state is incomplete, contradictory, or unvalidated, without explicitly flagging the gap.
Using generic programme knowledge as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents when those documents are present.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Sub-section 2.2 asserts a regulatory rule about grant agreement terms: 'For the placement, ownership of results is to follow the grant-agreement default, vesting in HUN-REN ATK as beneficiary acting through the fellow'. This grant-agreement-terms claim carries no source_ref to docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/ (its claim_status placement_ip_ownership cites only Tier 3 working_assumptions.json), and traceability_footer.primary_sources contains no Tier 1 path. Flagged conservatively per Constraint 3.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1–4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

decision_log_entries.resolution_note: A Phase 8 Tier 5 deliverable (impact_section.json) exists while the Phase 7 budget gate declares gate_pass_declaration: 'fail' (blocking inconsistency BLK-01, no lump-sum budget response received). Per CLAUDE.md §8.4 and §13.4 this is a blocking gate failure, not a hold state; no Phase 8 substep may exist before gate_09 confirms a complete, structurally consistent budget. Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution.

The placement IP-ownership statement invokes the 'grant-agreement default' (a grant-agreement-terms regulatory claim) without a Tier 1 (docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/) source reference in the artifact's traceability footer; it is grounded only in a Tier 3 working assumption. Flagged conservatively under Constraint 3. Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution.
